author: Sn1cE
quote: It’s 2026, and it’s truly a huge disappointment that players are still being forced to settle for a 30 FPS experience. It’s unacceptable that a multibillion-dollar production like GTA 6—which has been anticipated for years—can’t deliver smooth performance on today’s **** it’s well known that consoles have hardware limitations, why isn’t the PC version released simultaneously with the console versions? In an era where a significant portion of gamers own much more powerful computers, how fair is it to force everyone to be subject to the technical limitations of consoles?A major industry player like Rockstar shouldn’t put PC gamers on the back burner. Releasing the game on consoles first and making PC players wait for months—or perhaps even longer—is now a business decision that’s hard to **** matter how impressive a game’s graphics may be, smoothness and performance are just as important as the graphics themselves. Presenting 30 FPS in 2026 not as a luxury but as a standard we’re forced to accept is disrespectful to players.
